description.value: Cafe Mt Robson is a landmark stop on Yellowhead Highway 16 at the foot of Mount Robson Provincial Park, the highest peak in the Canadian Rockies and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Operating for over 100 years, the café micro-roasts its own organic fair-trade coffee in small batches and serves a full menu ranging from espresso drinks to homemade pizza and chuck wagon BBQ burgers. Sitting on a remote stretch roughly 100 km west of Jasper and 75 km east of McBride, it represents one of the few substantial commercial stops for cyclists travelling this corridor.

address.value: 18344 Yellowhead Highway 16, Mount Robson, BC, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record names this 'Mount Robson Store & Gift Shop' tagged shop=convenience, but the discovered URL resolves to 'Cafe Mt Robson,' a café and food-service operation — indicating a probable name mismatch or a multi-function location where the website represents only the café side. The website confirms an active business on Yellowhead Highway 16, provides phone numbers and an address absent from OSM, and lists a full hot food menu (soups, pizza, burgers, poutine), but contains no mention of convenience grocery retail, bike infrastructure, washrooms, or any other cyclist-specific amenities.
